mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%) does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls) does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between UNRATE and PAYEMS is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained increase in HOUST does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST growth and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a fall in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with service sector growth
failure_condition: If the joint condition (GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls) during economic expansion does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between GDPC1 and INDPRO is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
